interface.title: planetMagFields App (Planetary Magnetic Fields — 3D Explorer + Orbit Trajectory Field Calculator)
interface.field: Planetary science / geomagnetism and space physics
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and comparing published planetary magnetic field models, and predicting the field along spacecraft paths for mission planning or comparison with data
interface.what_it_is_for: Pick a planet and a published spherical-harmonic field model, see its radial field on a 3D globe with traced field lines, its Lowes power spectrum and dipolarity/symmetry numbers, and compute and export the model field (Br, Bθ, Bφ, |B|) along a spacecraft trajectory.

data.note: The field models ship with the app: Earth IGRF 14 (1900–2030), Jupiter JRM09/JRM33/VIP4, Saturn Cassini 11+, plus Mercury, Uranus, Neptune and Ganymede in the list. Trajectories came from the 'Load example' button (10 points), the 'Generate Example' elliptical orbit (100 points), and 4 points I typed into the paste box. No test files were available, so nothing was uploaded. The downloaded CSV earth_igrf14_orbit_field.csv had columns r, theta, phi, Br, Btheta, Bphi, Bmag for 10 rows.

features.name: Model picker with linked summary header
features.general: Pick an object, then one of the published models available for it; a header shows the key model parameters and a link to the source paper
features.specific: Planet select → Model select (list depends on the planet) → header shows Planet, Model (DOI link), ℓmax, Dipole tilt, r/Rp, Year; the Paper reference link updates
steps: Open the Planet list and choose a body
Open the Model list, which shows only that body's models
Read ℓmax, dipole tilt and the reference in the header
serves_tasks: Choose the object and the published model to examine
Compare the summary metrics across models or bodies

features.name: 3D globe of a surface field with traced field lines
features.general: Show a scalar field on a rotatable sphere with streamlines traced out from it, and set how many lines there are, how far they go and their colouring
features.specific: Plotly 3D globe of Br with coastlines (Earth only), field lines traced up to a max radius, rainbow or solid line colours, drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, reset camera
steps: Pick the number of field lines
Set the max tracing radius (Rp)
Pick the line colour and width
Drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, Reset camera to default
serves_tasks: Render the field on a 3D surface with traced field lines

features.name: Field units and colour scale control with symmetric/manual range
features.general: Choose the unit the field is shown in, choose a colormap, invert it, and switch between an automatic symmetric range and a manual min/max for a diverging field plot
features.specific: Field units select (e.g. µT, nT, Gauss; colorbar label follows), Colormap select, Invert colormap, Symmetric (auto ±max) checkbox; unticking it reveals vmin/vmax number fields that set the colorbar limits in the chosen unit
steps: Pick the field units and check the colorbar label
Pick a colormap
Optionally invert it
Untick Symmetric to show vmin/vmax
Type vmin and vmax in the chosen unit
serves_tasks: Adjust units and colour scaling so the figure reads well

features.name: Evaluation shell and epoch sliders with reset
features.general: Re-evaluate the model at a chosen time and at a chosen radius (inside or outside the reference surface), with a one-click reset to the surface
features.specific: Year slider (IGRF, 1900–2030) and Radius r/R_planet slider (0.5–5) with ↺ reset; the globe, dipole tilt, spectrum and metrics all update
steps: Drag or key the Year slider
Read the new dipole tilt and surface Br
Move the Radius slider to downward- or upward-continue
Press ↺ to return to r = 1
serves_tasks: See how the field changes over time and with depth or altitude

features.name: Spectrum and dipolarity/symmetry panel

features.specific: Show spectrum toggle → Lowes spectrum Rℓ (nT²) vs ℓ, plus Dipolarity (axial), Dipolarity (total), Axisymmetric and Equat. symmetric percentages
steps: Tick Show spectrum
Read the spectrum slope and its peaks
Read the four percentages
Change model, year or radius and compare (check the spectrum's ℓmax matches the header; it did not after switching to VIP4)
serves_tasks: Quantify how the field's energy is spread across scales and how dipolar and symmetric it is
Compare the summary metrics across models or bodies

features.name: Trajectory input with angle-unit choice

features.specific: θ/φ radian/degree radios; tabs for Paste Data (with Load example) and Upload File (CSV, 200MB); Compute field along trajectory; Clear trajectory data
steps: Set the θ and φ units first: changing them after data is loaded silently reinterprets and recomputes that data (screens/053.webp)
Choose the Paste Data tab (or Load example) or the Upload File tab
